title: Can I SURVIVE the Egg Opening?
summary: Rosen Score 'Egg Opening': spell E-G-G with your first three moves (e.g. e-pawn, g-pawn, g-pawn) and win vs ~2070 humans; Rosen Score website shown.
rules: Rosen Score 'word opening' challenge: the first letters of your first N moves in algebraic notation must spell the target word (pawn moves start with their file letter a-h; piece moves with B/N/R/Q/K, so 'B' can be a bishop move or a b-pawn move).
The opening only counts (Rosen Score trophy) if you go on to WIN the game; he aborts/abandons attempts when the opponent blocks the spelling.
Captures still count by the moving piece's first letter (e.g. a g-pawn capture is still 'G').
Target word: EGG -> your first 3 moves must start with the letters E, G, G.
win_condition: Spell EGG with your opening moves AND win the game.
